newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS/RAISES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS/RAISES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Wednesday it will raise its retail prices for gasolines in the Netherlands by two cents per litre with effect from Friday, October 18.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, the company said.
From Friday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations rises to 2.09 guilders per litre.
The price of premium with lead substitute rises to 2.15 guilders/litre and that of Euro regular unleaded to 2.04 guilders/litre.
The recommended price for diesel remains stable at 1.56 guilders per litre, Shell said.
